description: As an analyst I can filter all subcommands to a time window so I only see events from the relevant incident period
steps: wt-evtx timeline -d <dir> --after 2024-03-15T00:00:00Z --before 2024-03-16T00:00:00Z outputs only events in that range
wt-evtx sessions -d <dir> --after 2024-03-15T00:00:00Z outputs only sessions that overlap the window
wt-evtx processes -d <dir> --after 2024-03-15T00:00:00Z outputs only process events in range
wt-evtx frequency -d <dir> --after 2024-03-15T00:00:00Z scopes frequency counts to the window
passing --after with an RFC3339 timestamp works; invalid timestamps produce a clear error message
